function.name: people_detection
function.description: detects the people in view and returns how many people are present. Use this when the user asks: 'how many people are there?', 'is the room free?', or 'is anyone in there right now?'.

function.name: measure_co2
function.description: reads the CO2 concentration in the room in ppm and returns it with an air-quality verdict. Use this when the user asks: 'what's the CO2 level?', 'how is the air quality?', or 'does the room need airing out?'.

function.name: identify_face
function.description: opens the camera and identifies who is in front of it. Use this when the user asks: 'who is there?', 'who is in front of the camera?', or 'tell me who you recognize now'.
